name: Zellyo
subTitle1: A no-code eCommerce platform empowering businesses
subTitle2: to launch professional online stores in minutes.
tagline: Launch a beautiful online store in minutes — fast, fluid, and built for modern creators.
overview: Zellyo is a next-generation no-code eCommerce storefront builder engineered to remove technical barriers for entrepreneurs and creators. It delivers high-converting checkout flows, instant theme customization, and lightning-fast storefront speeds.
research: Conducted extensive usability testing and merchant workflow analysis to identify pain points in standard e-commerce setups. Findings demonstrated that zero-friction onboarding, automated catalog syncing, and high mobile conversion rates are critical for independent brand success.
design: Crafted an ultra-clean, minimalist interface with refined typography and responsive layout components. Designed an effortless drag-and-drop store customizer paired with distraction-free checkout funnels tailored to maximize sales conversion.
developmentSummary: Engineered with a high-performance modern web stack, automated CDN asset optimization, and real-time inventory management with instant global payment processing.
development: Architected using high-efficiency serverless endpoints, optimized React hydration, and real-time synchronization pipelines. Integrated robust webhooks for multi-currency payment providers, automated inventory alerts, and instant SEO indexing to ensure peak store performance.

name: Zenbrix Enterprise
subTitle1: A complete business management platform built to
subTitle2: streamline operations, sales, and team productivity.
tagline: Unified workforce management, site supervision, and automated real-time payroll operations.
overview: Zenbrix Enterprise is an all-in-one operational management SaaS engineered for modern organizations. From multi-site employee attendance and supervisor dispatching to automated payroll calculation and ledger accounting, Zenbrix centralizes business control into a single intelligent platform.
research: Conducted field interviews with enterprise operations directors, site managers, and HR heads. Research revealed heavy friction in manual timesheet reconciliation, overtime calculation errors, and delays in site expense reporting, defining our focus on automated calculations and instant record auditing.
design: Created a high-density, accessible dashboard UI with clear visual hierarchy, intuitive data tables, and rapid filter controls. Designed dedicated flows for supervisor site allocations, employee wage tracking, and one-click salary disbursements.
developmentSummary: Built with ultra-fast state handling, dynamic payroll engines, and enterprise-grade role-based security.
development: Implemented high-performance calculating engines for automated wage calculations, overtime adjustments, and tax deductions. Backed by encrypted cloud storage, audit-ready logs, and automated CSV/PDF report generation for seamless accounting integration.

name: BM Aesthetique
subTitle1: Dermatologically tested, uncomplicated skincare designed to
subTitle2: protect, repair, and restore natural skin balance.
tagline: Uncomplicated, luxury skincare backed by dermatological science and restorative formulations.
overview: BM Aesthetique is a premium skincare brand focused on clean, uncomplicated formulas that protect, repair, and restore the skin's natural balance. The platform offers a serene digital shopping experience featuring curated skin routines, transparent ingredient guides, and effortless checkout.
research: Analyzed consumer purchasing patterns in luxury cosmetic e-commerce. Discovered that customers value transparent ingredient breakdowns, routine-based product pairing recommendations, and seamless mobile payments above all else.
design: Designed an elegant, editorial aesthetic featuring warm neutral tones, sophisticated typography, and high-resolution product showcases. Emphasized soothing visuals and clear skin-benefit highlights across serums and sunscreens.
developmentSummary: Developed an ultra-fast headless e-commerce frontend with secure payment gateway integration.
development: Built with high-speed page loading, Razorpay checkout integration, real-time inventory tracking, and meta pixel analytics. Implemented smooth interactive carousels and instant customer support hooks for elevated user engagement.

name: Nivo Concepts
subTitle1: Constructing premium buildings and luxury interiors with
subTitle2: turnkey architectural planning and unmatched precision.
tagline: Beyond Walls, Beyond Expectations — Luxury Architecture, Engineering, and Turnkey Interiors.
overview: Nivo Concepts is a premier architectural construction and luxury interior design firm. Delivering turnkey residential and commercial projects, Nivo Concepts blends refined aesthetics with structural engineering excellence from initial 3D visualization to final interior handover.
research: Evaluated high-end architectural portfolio benchmarks and elite client consultation workflows. Found that prospective luxury clients prioritize immersive full-screen imagery, detailed material specifications, and clear project phase roadmaps.
design: Crafted an immersive architectural portfolio with dynamic dark/light viewing modes, expansive grid showcases, and elegant typography that lets spatial design and craftsmanship take center stage.
developmentSummary: Engineered with smooth scroll kinematics, high-resolution media optimization, and interactive project showcases.
development: Optimized high-resolution architectural imagery through modern WebP compression and responsive CDN caching. Integrated smooth scroll animations, interactive project galleries, and frictionless consultation inquiry forms.

name: Hamme
subTitle1: An engaging lifestyle and social mobile experience built with
subTitle2: intuitive onboarding, interactive profiles, and modern UI.
tagline: Next-generation lifestyle and social connectivity with intuitive onboarding and fluid micro-interactions.
overview: Hamme is an innovative mobile platform built for modern social and lifestyle interactions. Featuring an interactive multi-step onboarding flow, smart profile customization, and smooth gesture controls, Hamme delivers a dynamic and personalized mobile experience.
research: Studied user retention in mobile onboarding flows to minimize registration friction. Identified that interactive number pickers, visual progress indicators, and vibrant accent colors dramatically increase sign-up completion rates.
design: Designed an ergonomic, modern mobile UI with fluid wheel selectors, clean cards, rounded geometric components, and vibrant purple accent themes that feel alive and responsive.
developmentSummary: Engineered for 60fps micro-animations, fast token authentication, and instant cloud sync.
development: Developed with optimized mobile component lifecycles, low-latency API communication, secure authentication protocols, and native-feeling gesture navigations.
